seo.title: Accessibility Statement | RNC Landscaping
seo.description: RNC Landscaping aims to meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA on this website. Learn what we have done, known limits, and how to report an accessibility problem to us.

lede: We want everyone to be able to use this website, including people who use assistive technology.

sections.heading: Our target
body: We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at Level AA.

items.title: Contrast
items.body: Text and controls meet AA contrast ratios.

items.title: Keyboard
items.body: All links, menus and form steps work with a keyboard, with a visible focus outline.

items.title: Forms
items.body: Every field has a label, help text and clear error messages linked to the field.

items.title: Motion
items.body: Animation is minimal and turned off when you choose reduced motion.

sections.heading: Known limits
body: Some linked government pages and PDF documents are outside our control and may not meet the same standard.

sections.heading: Report a problem
body: If something doesn't work for you, contact us at [EMAIL] or [PHONE]. Tell us the page and what happened, and we'll work on a fix or give you the information another way.
